jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

Wir machen das Leben einfacher, sicherer und umweltfreundlicher, mit Technik, die mehr leistet, weniger verbraucht und für alle verfügbar ist. Mikroelektronik von Infineon ist der Schlüssel für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Wir achten auf schonenden Umgang mit natürlichen Ressourcen und lösen gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen: Effiziente Energienutzung, umweltgerechte Mobilität und Sicherheit in einer vernetzten Welt. 2 Staff Engineer Application Stress Test Methodologies (f/m/div) ID: HRC1166867

Join us at KAI and become a key player in the semiconductor industry, where every design and test brings us closer to a sustainable, electrified future! As our new Staff Engineer specializing in Application Stress Test Methodologies, you¿ll dive into the world of next-generation wide-bandgap power semiconductors, designing innovative test systems that explore performance under extreme conditions.

At KAI, we strive to create pioneering reliability test methods and systems for robust power semiconductor technologies. Your know-how in designing and developing test systems will help us push our technology to its limits while collaborating with a team of innovators.

Your new responsibilities:

Develop and design advanced power electronic circuits through simulations and concept studies

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather and manage system requirements effectively

Transform designs into hardware, overseeing the complete implementation process, and supervising the manufacturing phase

Evaluate and validate designs within an industrial laboratory setting

Lead stress testing using both established and newly developed test systems

Document designs, concepts, and results with clarity and precision

You are a hands-on innovator with a passion for high-performing power electronic systems. You thrive on bringing ideas to life, blending technical understanding with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Your toolkit for success includes:

Master's / PhD in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Strong expertise in SPICE and system-level simulations of power electronic circuits

Proven experience in PCB design using industry-standard tools like ALTIUM Designer

Practical experience with power electronic hardware design, from concept to laboratory validation

Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

The ability to lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative workspace

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry, at least employment group G (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. A higher payment is negotiable depending on your expertise and skills. Furthermore, Infineon offers additional employee benefits.

Apply to this position online by following the URL and entering the Job ID in our job search.

About us

At Life Couriers, we understand how important the critical moments in life are.

As the global leader in radiopharmaceutical and stem cell logistics, we have leveraged our experience with some of the world’s most time-critical shipments to expand our services to biopharmaceuticals, cell and gene therapies, laboratory specimens, clinical trials, organ transplants, medical devices, and more.

Because we know that a missed delivery can mean the loss of a life. That is why we have built our company culture around one clear priority: patient outcomes. Our employees are committed to improving, enriching, and saving lives through the power of logistics.

To strengthen our Controlling team, we are looking for a FP&A Controller (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible.

Your Responsibilities

- Drive monthly management reporting, business reviews and performance analyses for assigned business units
- Partner with business unit heads as a finance sparring partner, providing financial insights, challenging assumptions and supporting operational and strategic decision-making
- Support budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning processes, including the development and maintenance of financial models
- Analyze business performance and variances, identify key business drivers and translate financial data into actionable recommendations
- Support strategic finance initiatives, including commercial improvement, operational optimization, investment decisions and growth opportunities
- Develop and standardize reporting structures, KPIs and planning processes
- Ensure data quality through validation, reconciliation and continuous improvement of reporting processes
- Build and improve scalable FP&A and controlling processes to support the company’s next stage of growth

Your Profile

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, business administration, economics, business analytics or a comparable field
- First professional experience in FP&A, controlling, finance, audit, transaction services, consulting or business intelligence
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear and concise business insights
- Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other BI tools highly advantageous; knowledge of LucaNet or Business Central a plus
- Proactive, structured and independent working style with a hands-on mentality, strong ownership and attention to details
- Confident communication and strong business partnering skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with finance teams, business unit leaders and management in an international environment
- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

What We Offer

- A high-impact FP&A role with early responsibility for business unit performance and direct exposure to senior management
- The opportunity to shape finance structures, reporting, and decision-making in a growing and dynamic environment
- The opportunity to leverage and further develop your expertise across business partnering, analytics, strategic finance, transformation topics, and the value creation agenda of a private equity portfolio company
- A collaborative, international team with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and the opportunity to make a visible contribution
- Flexible working model including home office options and flexible working hours (flextime)
- 30 days of annual leave
- Access to employee benefits such as Wellpass or Sodexo
- A purpose-driven company environment, contributing to meaningful healthcare logistics at Life Couriers
- A modern, supportive workplace where your ideas and impact truly matter

Application

Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to receiving your application!

Please send your complete application (CV, cover letter, references), including your salary expectations and earliest possible start date, to: recruiting@lifecouriers.com (https://mailto:recruiting@lifecouriers.com)

We welcome applications from all backgrounds, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

What to Expect

Duraion: 6 monthsStart Date: January 2027Time type: full timeLocation: BerlinAs a Process Engineer intern, you will develop, implement, and optimize production processes related to the manufacturing of advanced magnetic materials, with a focus on conventional and powder processing methods. You will be responsible for improving material flow, equipment performance, and product consistency across the full production lifecycle—from powder preparation to sintering.

What You’ll Do

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and sustain manufacturing processes including powder blending, shaping (pressing, extrusion, casting), drying, debinding, and sintering. 
- Develop and maintain Process Flows, Control Plans, GR&R studies, Work Instructions, Rework Procedures, and Risk Assessments (PFMEA). 
- Analyze root causes of process and material failures  
- Collect and analyze process data to optimize key parameters affecting powder flowability, particle size distribution, green density, and final material properties. 
- Author and maintain standard operating procedures, manufacturing instructions, and training documentation for ceramic process steps. 
- Support production operations by working with technicians and operators to troubleshoot real-time manufacturing issues.

What You’ll Bring

- Fluency in English
- MSc studies (ongoing) in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
- Strong mathematical and physics background as well as analytical thinking and problem-solving ability.
- Strong interest in electromechanical systems, motors, actuators, and precision mechanisms
- Hands-on mindset with interest in building, testing, and debugging mechanical systems

In the heart of Berlin, we combine expertise in the areas of finance, HR, supply chain, procurement, product safety and IT. We focus on digital and customer-focused solutions, to create services for future. Learn more about us and our location-independent work models at basf.com/en/servicehub-berlin.
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Insurance Manager (f/m/d) Liability / Financial Lines (Versicherungsprüfer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In close collaboration with your team, you will play a key role within the global insurance and risk management of Siemens Energy. Working closely with your team, brokers, and insurers, you will actively shape the placement of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs in the international insurance market, provide advisory support to business units on complex contracts, and manage challenging claims. Your daily responsibilities will integrate legal and insurance expertise, strategic business thinking, negotiation skills, and the ability to effectively communicate complex issues.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for the design, placement, implementation, and management of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs, including the development of insurance terms and coverage concepts, considering the needs and risk profile of our business units
* Advising and placing liability project insurance
* Primary contact for insurance-related questions regarding contract structures and active participation in contract negotiations worldwide
* Supporting business units in reporting and processing insurance claims, as well as analysing and evaluating insurance solutions. Independently handling complex claims, with a particular focus on operational, product, and environmental liability claims, and managing claims processes abroad
* First point of contact for senior management-related questions regarding insurance coverage for the board and management in accordance with German corporate law

What You Bring

* Several years of relevant professional experience in a comparable position or relevant industry experience, particularly in the placement of international insurance programs, contract commentary, and claims handling in international project business
* Fluent in German (C1/C2) and English (C1), both written and spoken. Additional language skills, such as Spanish, are desirable
* Analytical skills and a confident approach to complex issues, connecting legal, technical, and economic aspects into clear recommendations
* Confident in negotiations, high level of personal responsibility, structured working style, and enjoyment of proactive topic advancement
* Proficient in all common MS Office applications and generative AI, with an affinity for implementing digital processes

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Corteco is an internationally leading supplier in the open automotive replacement parts market. As a subsidiary of the global Freudenberg Group, we supply over 26,000 articles in OEM quality. In seals and vibration control technology as well as cabin air filters, this makes the product range of an original equipment manufacturer available to independent workshops and replacement parts dealers as well. Corteco is represented with its own sales offices in over 15 countries. Through the Freudenberg Group, we reach customers in 60 countries around the world.

Pinerolo - (TO)
Corteco GmbH

Freudenberg Aftermarket (FAM) is a newly established Business Group bringing together aftermarket activities from across the Freudenberg Group into one focused global organization. This opportunity is open to talent based at either of our locations in Weinheim, Germany, or Pinerolo, Italy.
We are looking for a finance professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with accounting expertise, business acumen, and a continuous improvement mindset. In this role, you will help establish the financial reporting and accounting governance foundations that support a growing international business.

Financial Analyst Group Reporting, Consolidation & Accounting Governance (f/m/d)

Responsibilities

- Drive Financial Transparency: Ensure accurate, reliable, and timely financial reporting across the Business Group while supporting key management and corporate reporting requirements.
- Support Consolidation & Closing Activities: Contribute to monthly and quarterly consolidation processes, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with Group standards.
- Strengthen Accounting Governance: Coordinate key accounting topics across international entities and support the resolution of complex accounting and audit-related matters.
- Provide Meaningful Insights: Transform financial data into clear analyses and management information that support sound business decisions.
- Partner Across the Organization: Collaborate with Finance teams, Shared Services, auditors, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and effective issue resolution.
- Drive Process Excellence: Identify opportunities to improve reporting, closing, and governance processes through standardization, digitalization, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Extensive years of experience in group reporting, consolidation, financial controlling, accounting governance, or corporate finance within an international environment.
- Strong knowledge of IFRS, consolidation principles, financial reporting, month-end closing, provisions, accruals, and balance sheet management.
- Proven ability to analyze complex financial topics, challenge assumptions, and deliver high-quality results with accuracy and ownership.
- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills, combined with a solid understanding of business impact.
- Experience partnering across multiple entities, functions, and stakeholders in an international organization.
- Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and finance transformation projects.
- Strong command of Excel, financial systems, and reporting tools; experience with HFM/Hyperion, Power BI, SAP BI, or similar platforms is an advantage.
- Fluent English; German is an advantage.
